sources.quote: WASP-50, also named Chaophraya, is a G-type main-sequence star about 594 light-years away in the constellation Eridanus.

sources.quote: The star is older than the Sun and slightly depleted in heavy elements compared to the Sun, and has a close to average starspot activity.
